newsitem.title: USA: Sears buys $100 million pest control business.
newsitem.headline: Sears buys $100 million pest control business.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck & Co. said Tuesday it completed the acquisition of All America Termite and Pest Control Inc., the nation's third-largest termite and pest control business.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
All America, based in Orlando, Fla., has operated under Sears' name since 1982. It had revenues of more than $100 million in 1996.
"The acquisition of All America positions us for strong growth in this segment," said Jane Thompson, president of Sears Home Services.

Sears is the largest provider of home related services, including home improvements, heating and air conditioning services, and product repair services. The Hoffman Estates, Ill.-based company operates more than 800 department stores and more than 2,500 free-standing stores.
Sears' stock edged up 12.5 cents to $54.375 on the New York Stock Exchange.
